title: tsuga canadensis var. pumila
intro: Tsuga canadensis var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Eastern Hemlock, is a small evergreen coniferous tree or shrub native to North America, belonging to the Pinaceae family. The health benefits of Tsuga canadensis var. pumila include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, as well as its potential to reduce stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs, and its potential sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Tsuga canadensis var. pumila include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
